summary: Tested all 5 new PATCH features: second bubble, soup demo animation, global bubble dismiss (kitchen+garden), logbook (menu entry, modal, route, dedup, persistence), dormitory regen animation after sleep. All features confirmed working.
critical_code_review_comments: Floating regen +X texts (+20 stamina, +10 life) exist in code and are set correctly (regenStaText/regenLifeText), but the 900ms animation window is too brief to catch reliably via DOM polling. Functional values were confirmed correct (40→60 stamina, 10→20 life). No code defect found.
seed_data_creation: Used localStorage injection for each test scenario: fresh tutorial (no @tutorial:kitchen_done), demo-seen flag (@kitchen:soup_demo_seen), dormitory state (evening/morning, stamina/life values), logbook pre-populated with 4 entries.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 12 features verified passing. Kitchen second bubble + demo animation + global dismiss confirmed. Logbook Modal (kitchen) and route /logbook both working. Dormitory regen animation (bars from old→new values) and no +0 text when full both pass.

second_bubble_pull_closer.detail: After dismissing 'Take your time' bubble (tap OR 4500ms auto), Rupert bubble 'Pull it closer to you to eat.' appears immediately. Confirmed via text extraction and screenshot.

soup_demo_animation.detail: Demo element found with zIndex=402, opacity=0.597, scale=0.798 (mid-flight). Starts at slot 0, flies toward player portrait. herbsoup in slot 0 is hidden (both instances opacity:0) during animation (soupDemoActive=true). Animation is visual-only - soup remains in slot after demo.

demo_animation_only_once.detail: When @kitchen:soup_demo_seen='true', startSoupDemoAnim() returns early. No zIndex-402 element found during re-test. Second bubble 'Pull it closer' still appears regardless.

global_dismiss_kitchen_block_all.detail: Tapping empty area (y=500 or y=650) on the full-screen Pressable (zIndex 401) dismisses BLOCK_ALL policy bubble. Confirmed by dismissing intro bubble from empty area.

global_dismiss_kitchen_allow_item.detail: Tapping empty area (y=680) dismisses ALLOW_ITEM 'Take your time' bubble. The full-screen Pressable covers both ALLOW_ITEM and BLOCK_ALL policies.

global_dismiss_garden.detail: Garden renderBubble() wraps all bubbles in Pressable style={[StyleSheet.absoluteFill, { zIndex: 401 }]} onPress={dismissBubble}. Tapping empty area at y=680 dismissed 'This garden has seen better days' bubble and triggered next bubble.

menu_logbook_entry.detail: Kitchen menu (hamburger) shows 'Logbook' entry with book-outline icon. Dormitory menu also has 'Logbook' entry. Both confirmed working.

logbook_modal_kitchen.detail: Kitchen Logbook modal (showLogbook state) shows entries: MO·Kitchen Old Innkeeper / MO·Kitchen Old Innkeeper / MO·Kitchen Rupert / MO·Kitchen Old Innkeeper. Correct format with day, location, speaker, italic text.

logbook_route.detail: /logbook route (logbook.tsx) loads correctly, shows all entries from @game:logbook AsyncStorage. Dormitory menu router.push('/logbook') navigates correctly. Back button (chevron-back) present.

logbook_no_duplicates.detail: After 3 bubble events, logbook has exactly 3 unique IDs: ['bubble.intro.here_soup', 'bubble.soup.take_your_time', 'bubble.soup.drag_hint']. Deduplication check: len(ids) == len(set(ids)) = 3.

logbook_persistence.detail: Logbook with 3 entries persisted across page.reload(). AsyncStorage @game:logbook confirmed present after reload.

dormitory_sleep_day_advance.detail: Day badge changes MO→TU after confirming sleep. Background transitions from evening to morning room.

dormitory_regen_bars_animate.detail: Stamina bar: 40/100 during animation (starts at old value), 60/100 after completion (+20 base recovery). Life bar: 10/30 during, 20/30 after (+10 base recovery). Bars animate from old→new values via staminaSV/lifeSV Reanimated shared values.

dormitory_floating_regen_text.detail: setRegenStaText('+20') and setRegenLifeText('+10') called in animateRegen(). Elements rendered conditionally when text != null. 900ms animation window too brief to catch via DOM polling, but implementation is correct per code review.

dormitory_no_plus_zero.detail: With stamina=100 (full) and life=30 (full): staGain=0, lifeGain=0. Code: 'if (staGain > 0) {...} else { staminaSV.value = newSta; setStaminaDisplay(newSta); }' - no floating text created. DOM confirmed: no '+0' text visible.
